# Feature: Reusable item visual tools hooks

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-10 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Extract Item Workbench →2D / →3D (and related visual tool actions) into reusable hooks + toolbar under `app/items/visuals`, so any item surface can compose the same convert/upload/generate affordances — not only inline logic inside `ItemVisualsPanel`. Roadmap: chat-driven (Stufe B) — item visuals reuse.

## Preconditions

- Item definition editable (personal/world) with optional thumbnail / model3d.
- Workbench already has visual tools row (`data-item-workbench-visual-tools`).

## Happy Path

- [ ] `useItemAssets` / `useItemModel3dAssets` live under `app/items/visuals` and are exported from `app/items` public barrel.
- [ ] `useItemVisualTools` exposes capabilities + handlers (to2d snapshot, to3d generate/switch, upload, enlarge, meshy 2d) independent of Workbench panel layout.
- [ ] `ItemVisualToolsBar` + `ItemVisualModeToggle` are presentational and used by `ItemVisualsPanel`.
- [ ] Workbench Visuals row still shows Upload / Enlarge / →2D / →3D / Meshy with same `data-item-workbench-visual-*` attrs (contract scripts pass).
- [ ] Cardinality unchanged: one generate/snapshot action per click (existing submit locks).

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Read-only / no canEdit → convert tools hidden or disabled as before.
- [ ] No 3D preview → →2D disabled with explanatory tooltip.
- [ ] Meshy not configured → generate disabled; →3D still switches mode.

## Regression

- [ ] Item library cards unchanged (thumbnail only; no accidental 3D mount).
- [ ] `npm run test-gate` item-workbench / thumbnail / model3d checks pass.
- [ ] Architecture boundary: no Supabase in app hooks beyond existing infrastructure facades.

## Assumptions

- First consumer remains Workbench; Library/Inventory do not mount convert tools in this slice (hooks ready for later).
- Preview capture stays injectable via callback (Three preview refs stay in composing panel).
